items.title: Google Agent Development Kit for Kotlin Reaches Feature Parity with Python, Supports On-Device AI
items.blurb: Google has released the Agent Development Kit (ADK) for Kotlin 1.0, a production-ready framework for building AI agents across Kotlin, Android, and JVM/server applications.

items.title: The new AgentCore Runtime is now available in Amazon Bedrock AgentCore
items.blurb: Today, AWS announces the availability of the next generation of AgentCore Runtime , the serverless microVM compute within Amazon Bedrock AgentCore.

items.title: Amazon Quick now generates individual sheets and builds analyses from an image
items.blurb: Amazon Quick now expands Generate Analysis with two new ways to create dashboards faster.

items.title: AWS PrivateLink announces Tunnel Endpoints to access network segments
items.blurb: AWS PrivateLink customers can now use VPC endpoint to privately and securely access network segments in another VPC/account.

items.title: Amazon ECS deployment observability for Amazon ECS Managed Daemons in AWS Management Console
items.blurb: Amazon Elastic Container Service (Amazon ECS) now provides a consolidated deployment view for Amazon ECS Managed Daemons, giving you a single place to see how far a deployment has progressed, what is failing, and what could stop it.

items.title: Amazon SES now supports tenant-level deliverability insights
items.blurb: Amazon Simple Email Service (SES) now supports tenant-level deliverability insights in Virtual Deliverability Manager (VDM). Tenant management allows email senders to isolate email sending across customers, business units, or applications.

items.title: AWS Builder Center now available as mobile app on iOS and Android
items.blurb: AWS Builder Center is a platform that brings together the global builder community, offering articles, workshops, sandbox environments, events, and learning resources in one place.
